category: Elements of a Non-Musical Theatrical Play
explanation: Script, Rehearsal, Stage, and Audience are all fundamental components or activities of a traditional, non-musical theatrical play. A "Score" specifically refers to a musical composition and is only relevant for musicals, not all plays.

category: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: The Great Pyramid of Giza, Temple of Artemis at Ephesus, Colossus of Rhodes, and Lighthouse of Alexandria are all traditionally listed among the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. The Pantheon, while an impressive ancient Roman structure, is not included in that list.
Madam, Level, Racecar, and Rotor are all palindromes, meaning they read the same forwards and backwards. Apple does not share this property.
